description: Notification sent to a user when they have been removed from a chat room by a room admin or the room creator.
subject: You've been removed from chat room "$room_name"
body:
Hello $user_name,

This is to let you know that you have been removed from the chat room "$room_name" by a room admin.

Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Room:       $room_name
Action:     Removed (kick)
By:         $actor_name
Date:       $action_date
Reason:     $reason
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What this means:
• You are no longer a member of this room and can't see new messages there.
• You can rejoin a public room from the Public Rooms tab; for a private room you'd need a fresh invitation.
• If you believe this was a mistake, please contact the room admin shown above.

Kind regards,
University Communications

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
